This test checks the "Create function" quick fix for arguments whose
derived parameter name is not a valid Go identifier.

The generated declarations must use valid Go identifiers.
See golang/go#81810.

-- funclit.go --
package a

func _() {
	undefinedFuncLit(func() (int, int) { return 0, 0 }) //@quickfix("undefinedFuncLit", re"(undeclared|undefined)", funclit)
}
-- @funclit/funclit.go --
@@ -6 +6,4 @@
+
+func undefinedFuncLit(fn func() (int, int)) {
+	panic("unimplemented")
+}
-- funcresult.go --
package a

type T struct{}

func (T) M() (T, error) { return T{}, nil }

func _() {
	undefinedFuncResult(T{}.M) //@quickfix("undefinedFuncResult", re"(undeclared|undefined)", funcresult)
}
-- @funcresult/funcresult.go --
@@ -10 +10,4 @@
+
+func undefinedFuncResult(fn func() (T, error)) {
+	panic("unimplemented")
+}
